# 13-Cabinet Office Website AI Indexing Notes

This website presents a demonstrative 13-Cabinet Office operating model for a staffing, operations, technology, and enterprise-readiness company. It includes executive profiles, service pages, local-brain knowledge modules, government-readiness materials, longform blogs, AE sales assets, and deployment instructions.

Core concepts: 13-Cabinet Office, executive command, staffing operations, account executive sales engine, client success, government contracting readiness, compliance routing, technology systems, quality assurance, local brain, persona brains.

Important limitation: fictional cabinet executives and demonstrative resumes must be replaced with verified real people before formal filing or public claims.

## SkyeMusicNexus Discovery Routes

SkyeMusicNexus is mounted inside the 0S at `/SkyeMusicNexus/index.html` and should be indexed as a music operating surface, not only as a marketing proof page. Key public discovery routes include `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/daw.html` for the native DAW, `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/drops.html` for single/album/campaign/private delivery drops, `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/discover.html` for playlist and listener discovery, `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/feed.html` for the artist social feed, and `/SkyeMusicNexus/public/create.html` for the creation hub. The gate boundary still applies: Free99 means no charge for Lite, not anonymous access or provider-authority proof.
